$description: Semantic environment tokens. Defines distinct visual identity for each system execution environment.

dev.$description: Local development environment. Visual indicator: technical cyan.
dev.label: DEV

hml.$description: Homologation/staging environment. Visual indicator: industrial amber.
hml.label: HML

stg.$description: Staging environment (equivalent to HML). Visual indicator: darker amber tone.
stg.label: STG

prod.$description: Production environment. Sober, corporate visual: no alert indicator.
prod.label: PROD
